data.title: Debt collection demand from Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH (unpaid internet bills)
data.summary: The debt collection agency Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH, acting for Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH, demands payment of €131.48 (unpaid internet invoices for August and September 2026, plus a reminder fee and collection costs) by 2 December 2026.
data.explanation: A debt collection agency (Inkassobüro) is demanding €131.48 on behalf of your internet provider for two unpaid invoices, a reminder fee the provider already charged, and its own collection fee. Pay the full amount to the trust account named in the letter by the stated deadline, or, if you think the claim is wrong, write back with your reasons so they can check it with the provider before the deadline. If you ignore it, the agency or its client may take further steps to collect the debt, which could include legal action, though this letter itself does not state that. If you are unsure whether the charges are correct, check your own records or contact the provider first.

key_facts.label: Payment deadline
key_facts.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
